consequence.statement: cilium_ces_sync_errors_total disappears from Cilium's exported metrics in 1.16; anything scraping, charting, or alerting on it simply stops receiving data for it, though Cilium itself keeps running.
consequence.remediation: Remove or update dashboards and alert rules that reference cilium_ces_sync_errors_total.

original.statement: Cilium 1.16 removes the cilium_ces_sync_errors_total metric, listed under "Removed Metrics" in the 1.16 upgrade notes, so it is no longer exported.

decision.reason: [ev-36f95ff2158c] lists `cilium_ces_sync_errors_total` under "1.16 Upgrade Notes › Removed Metrics", so in 1.16 the metric is no longer exported. Nothing in the evidence says that Cilium, an upgrade or any resource fails, so no action-eligible kind is justified. Because Cilium keeps running and only consumers of the metric stop getting data, behavior-change (review, low severity) is the cautious, fitting kind. Removing or updating dashboards and alert rules is the matching remediation.
